SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDeviceCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(A.CurrentRadioType)) = 'LTE-R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lteCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(A.CurrentRadioType)) = 'VHF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vhfCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(A.AutoSwitchingRadio) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoSwitchCnt, ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED)), 1) AS avgRsrp, ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED)), 1) AS avgRsrq, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -90 OR CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cautionDeviceCnt, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(A.RCV_DT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRcvDt FROM tbl_last_data A INNER JOIN tbl_router_info R ON A.VoLTE_NUM = R.volte_num WHERE 1=1
AND R.company_code = #{companyCode}
